services.question: What services does Bandlik.uz offer?
services.answer: The platform helps employers find workers for the profession they need, and helps candidates apply for verified vacancies abroad and take preparation courses.

request.question: How do I submit a worker request?
request.answer: Click the “Request workers” button and specify the profession, number of workers, language level and working conditions. We will review your request and get in touch with you.

price.question: How much do the services cost?
price.answer: The price depends on the size of the request and the working conditions. A responsible specialist will tell you the exact price after you submit a request.

verified.question: Are the vacancies verified?
verified.answer: Yes, every vacancy on the platform is checked in advance for the employer and the working conditions.

available.question: What vacancies are available?
available.answer: There are jobs abroad in cooking, construction, warehousing, manufacturing and many other fields. The full list is in the “Vacancies” section.

apply.question: How do I apply for a vacancy?
apply.answer: Choose the vacancy you want, click the “Details” button and submit an application with the required documents.

courses.question: How do I sign up for language and vocational courses?
courses.answer: Choose a suitable course in the “Preparation courses” section and register. Information about the lessons will be sent to you.

partner.question: How can I join as a partner?
partner.answer: Write or call us through the “Contact” section. We will discuss the terms of cooperation together.

contact.heading: Get in touch
contact.intro: Do you have questions or suggestions? Get in touch with us.

cta.text: Choose the path that fits you and take the next step.

hero.title: About us
hero.text: Bandlik.uz is a platform that coordinates cooperation between candidates, employers and licensed private employment agencies in a digital environment.
hero.alt: Bandlik flag in front of buildings

approach.label: Our approach
approach.text: The platform helps coordinate work with vacancies, documents and requests in a digital environment. Placement abroad itself is carried out by private employment agencies holding the required license.

problem.label: The problem
problem.title: Trust and transparency matter when getting a job abroad.
problem.text: People looking for work abroad can run into illegal intermediaries, fake vacancies and costs that were never stated up front. This creates mistrust and misunderstandings along the way.

solution.label: Our solution
solution.title: We bring employment processes together on one digital platform.
solution.text: The platform lets you browse vacancies, manage candidate data, coordinate the flow of documents and follow the placement process. The result is a clearer, more transparent digital environment for everyone involved.
solution.alt: Suitcases and documents ready for the trip

mission.label: Our goal
mission.title: We coordinate employment abroad in a single digital environment.
mission.text: Bandlik.uz simplifies cooperation between candidates, employers and licensed private employment agencies. The platform lets you browse vacancies, manage candidate data, coordinate documents and follow placement processes.

hero.title: Verified workers — through licensed agencies.
hero.text: Find workers with the skills and experience your company needs. Leave a request and our coordinator will contact you within 24 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Bandlik.uz takes the protection of users’ personal data seriously. This policy explains how data is collected, used and stored.

collected.title: What data we collect
collected.text: When you submit a request, an application or a message, you give us details such as your name, phone number, message and the documents needed for an application. Technical data, such as browser type and language, may also be collected automatically when you use the site.

usage.title: How we use your data
usage.text: Your data is used only to review your request or application, to contact you, to improve the platform and to meet legal requirements.

sharing.title: Sharing data
sharing.text: Data is shared with employers and partners only to the extent needed to process your request or application, and with your knowledge. We do not sell personal data.

security.title: Storage and security
security.text: Data is stored for as long as needed for these purposes and is protected against unauthorized access by technical and organizational measures.

rights.title: Your rights and contact
rights.text: You may ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time. Write or call us through the “Contact” section of this website.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using the Bandlik.uz platform you agree to the following terms.

service.title: About the service
service.text: Bandlik.uz is a platform that connects employers with candidates and offers preparation courses. The platform itself is not an employer.

usage.title: Using the platform
usage.text: You agree to provide accurate information, not to misuse the platform and not to submit other people’s data without their consent.

vacancies.title: Vacancies and information
vacancies.text: Vacancies, salaries and working conditions are shown as provided by employers and checked in advance. Details may change, so confirm the final terms before signing an agreement.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: We make reasonable efforts to keep the platform available and accurate, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation or any particular hiring result.

changes.title: Changes and contact
changes.text: These terms may be updated from time to time; the current version is always on this page. For questions, use the “Contact” section.
